status_summary: HUD published a proposed rule on 2026-03-02 (91 FR 10016) that would let public housing agencies and certain project-based rental assistance owners impose work requirements and term limits in public housing, Housing Choice Vouchers, Project-Based Vouchers and Project-Based Rental Assistance. It would be optional for each agency or owner, not a national requirement. Work requirements could reach up to 40 hours a week for assisted adults aged 18 to 61, with exclusions for disability, primary caregivers, pregnancy, children under 6 and full-time students; term limits would run at least two years for non-elderly, non-disabled families and apply prospectively. Comments closed on 2026-05-01, and the Federal Register shows no final rule on the subject through 2026-10-07. Separately, on 2026-09-01 HUD published a revised Operations Notice for the Moving to Work expansion (91 FR 56163) that loosens the safe-harbor limits on optional MTW work requirement and term-limit waivers, raising the cap to 40 hours a week per person, removing the household cap and lowering the minimum term to two years; comments are due 2026-11-02, and when the changes take effect was not confirmed. No statute on the subject was found.
